title: CarsSearch requests manifest
description: Schema for Requests/index.json — the manifest of every search request. GitHub Pages serves no directory listing, so the viewer discovers requests through this file. It is DERIVED: never hand-edited, always regenerated wholesale from the individual request.json files, which is what keeps it merge-conflict-proof.

generated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the regeneration that produced this file.

requests.description: One row per request, newest-first is not required — the viewer sorts by date_of_request.

request_id.description: Stable id, also the folder name under Requests/.

title.description: Human-readable label shown in the request picker.

request_path.description: Repo-root-relative path to this request's request.json. The viewer lives in docs/ and prefixes '../'.

results_path.description: Repo-root-relative path to this request's results.json.

favorites_path.description: Repo-root-relative path to this request's favorites.json.

search_state.description: Mirror of request.json's system_fields.search_state, so the picker can show live progress without loading every request file.

group.description: Display name of the group currently being searched; null when idle/done.

brand.description: Display name of the brand currently being searched; null when idle/done.

models.description: Number of model entries in this request's results.json.

offerings.description: Total offerings across all of this request's models.
